resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or equivalent open-source plane-wave DFT code)
resources.notes: Any open-source DFT code capable of plane-wave calculations with pseudopotentials (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, ABINIT) can be used.

resources.name: PBE pseudopotentials for Ge, As, Ga (e.g., SSSP library)
resources.notes: Use PBE pseudopotentials for Ge, As, Ga from the SSSP efficiency or precision library, or equivalent.

resources.name: Atomsk (or equivalent grain boundary construction tool)
resources.notes: Optional; the supercell can also be constructed manually from crystallographic data.
